name: Export, load, serve (first run)
summary: first_run.py runs the warehouse export to results/<stamp>, loads it into audit.duckdb, then python -m app.api serves it.

name: Refresh in the app
summary: POST /api/refresh runs export + load as subprocesses into audit-<stamp>.duckdb, switches AUDIT_DB and the current_db pointer.

name: API request: tab to JSON
summary: Tab hook -> web/src/api.ts getJson -> FastAPI route -> service.load_outcome -> app/core/data DuckDB read -> JSON.

name: Running as a Databricks App
summary: app_start unpacks DuckDB, starts app.api on DATABRICKS_APP_PORT; export auths with token (run_as user) or SP OAuth M2M (run_as app); viewer email drives rls.

name: Run the app locally
summary: venv + pip install, fill .env, python tools/first_run.py, python -m app.api, open http://127.0.0.1:8000/.

name: Deploy as a Databricks App
summary: Stage app + split DuckDB wheel + app.yaml, databricks sync, apps create/update/start/deploy, print grants for run_as app.

name: Configuration and secrets
summary: settings.yml + settings.local.yml overlay via load_settings; app.yml for deploy/rls; DATABRICKS_* credentials from .env or env.

name: Databricks SQL warehouse
summary: The only remote compute: every check, names and tags query runs on it through databricks-sql-connector.

name: Databricks system tables (system.*)
summary: Read-only sources of every check: access, billing, compute, lakeflow, query, serving, storage, data_classification, ai_gateway.

name: Databricks Apps
summary: Hosts the app; sets DATABRICKS_APP_PORT, X-Forwarded-Email and (per code comment) DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.

name: Databricks CLI
summary: databricks current-user/sync/apps get|create|update|start|deploy, run by deploy_app.cli.

name: Workspace folder /Workspace/Users/<user>/<name>
summary: Where deploy syncs the staged app code (and app.yaml, which holds the token for run_as user).

name: PyPI (pip download duckdb)
summary: deploy downloads the DuckDB cp311 manylinux wheel once on the deploying machine.

name: Browser (React UI)
summary: Built UI from app/web/dist calling /api/* with fetch.

name: Export folder results/<stamp>
summary: Parquet per check (findings/), dims/, tags/, storage/, entitlements/, manifest.json, report.json, report.md.

name: Local DuckDB audit.duckdb (or audit-<stamp>.duckdb)
summary: Schemas findings, dims, tags, governance, storage, usage, warehouse, rls + direct_export_meta; sidecar <db>.run_results.json.

name: current_db.txt pointer
summary: Atomic pointer to the db the last load/refresh built; second in the db resolution order.

name: DATABRICKS_SERVER_HOSTNAME
summary: Workspace host (no https://); from .env, env or app.yaml.

name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH
summary: SQL warehouse HTTP path; from .env, env or app.yaml.

name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
summary: PAT with SELECT on system.*; optional when the app SP is used; stored in app.yaml only for run_as user.

name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
summary: App service principal OAuth client id, set by Databricks Apps (code comment).

name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET
summary: App service principal OAuth secret, set by Databricks Apps (code comment).

name: DATABRICKS_HOST
summary: https://<host> passed to the Databricks CLI by deploy.

name: config/settings.yml
summary: Tracked app settings; overlaid by settings.local.yml.

name: config/settings.local.yml
summary: Git-ignored overrides merged over settings.yml (wins key by key).

name: config/app.yml
summary: Databricks App name, run_as (user|app) and rls block.

name: config/app.local.yml
summary: Git-ignored overrides of app.yml; not copied to the app.

name: .env
summary: Git-ignored credentials file (3 DATABRICKS_* values); parsed by _load_dotenv.

name: app.yaml (staged)
summary: Databricks App manifest written by deploy: command python tools/app_start.py + env.

name: config/thresholds.yml
summary: Per-check :param overrides.

name: config/materiality.yml
summary: Per-check materiality floors.

name: config/tag_aliases.yml
summary: top_tags for the top-bar filters.

name: config/library_corrections.yml
summary: Known vendored-query defects register.

name: config/workspace.csv
summary: Workspace tags / catalog pins applied at load.

name: discount_pct
summary: List-price discount fraction; what-if money columns. Default 0.0.

name: default_window
summary: Default window and export days: 7/30/90. Default 30.

name: include_today
summary: Export today's partial day. Default true.

name: ui.max_rows
summary: Default page LIMIT in read_finding. Default 500.

name: ui.max_chart_categories
summary: Top-N before Other in charts. Default 8.

name: mandatory_tag_keys
summary: 1-5 tags every object should carry. Shipped [cost_center, domain, environment].

name: export_tag_keys
summary: Tag names the export keeps; default all.

name: load.memory_limit
summary: DuckDB memory cap for load and app. Default 1GB.

name: load.threads
summary: DuckDB threads for load and app. Default 4.

name: load.top_tag_keys
summary: Tag keys kept in tags.tag_entity by spend. Default 10.

name: tag_coverage_floor
summary: Workspace tag coverage floor. Default 0.5.

name: tag_share_floor
summary: Workspace dominant-value share floor. Default 0.6.

name: admin_groups
summary: Groups whose broad grants read OK.

name: brand
summary: Name, url, contact in header/footer and query_source fallback.

name: privacy.mask_user_identities
summary: Mask user emails/names in export and on screen. Default false.

name: query_source
summary: Source tag / user agent on app queries; default brand name.

name: query_tags
summary: SET QUERY_TAGS on every export session and dashboard.

name: table_sizes
summary: DESCRIBE DETAIL / volume listing settings for the export.

name: sources
summary: system.* table -> replacement view/table.

name: contract
summary: Databricks commit for burndown.

name: dashboards
summary: Dashboard snapshot schema and sizes job schema.

name: app.yml name
summary: App name, 2-30 lowercase/digits/dashes.

name: app.yml run_as
summary: user (token in app.yaml) or app (service principal, no token).

name: app.yml rls
summary: Row-level access: enabled, table, columns, apply (query|export).

name: AUDIT_DB
summary: Db the app opens, first priority; Refresh sets it.

name: AUDIT_DATA_DIR
summary: Data folder outside the repo.

name: AUDIT_CONFIG_DIR
summary: Config folder override.

name: AUDIT_API_HOST
summary: Bind host; default 127.0.0.1 (0.0.0.0 on Apps).

name: AUDIT_API_PORT
summary: Bind port; default 8000 (DATABRICKS_APP_PORT on Apps).

name: DATABRICKS_APP_PORT
summary: Set by Databricks Apps; marks app mode (rls.is_app) and port.

name: AUDIT_DBX_CATALOG
summary: Compile catalog; default system.

name: AUDIT_SNAPSHOT_DIR
summary: dbt snapshot folder.

name: GET /api/status
summary: Bootstrap state: settings_invalid | no_database | build_incomplete | ready.

name: GET /api/refresh
summary: Refresh status.

name: POST /api/refresh
summary: Start export + load (days 1-90, default 30).

name: GET /api/meta
summary: as_of, windows, model counts, brand, rls, direct_export info.

name: GET /api/workspaces
summary: dims.dim_workspace rows with region status.

name: GET /api/dims
summary: Job/cluster/warehouse/pipeline/notebook names (masked when on).

name: GET /api/coverage
summary: Source states, checks_not_ok, truncation, library corrections, region.

name: GET /api/guide
summary: Guide tab feed.

name: GET /api/guide/sql/{query_id}
summary: Runnable Databricks SQL for a check.

name: GET /api/rollup
summary: Nested cost/perf rollup for one tag key.

name: GET /api/rollup/top
summary: Top tag values by $ or query time.

name: GET /api/rollup/keys
summary: Tag keys seen in the window.

name: GET /api/tag_origins
summary: Dollars the tag filter keeps, by where the value was set.

name: GET /api/workspace_tags
summary: Workspace tag values with floors.

name: GET /api/abac_policies
summary: ABAC policies.

name: GET /api/workspace_usage
summary: Workspace data usage.

name: GET /api/workspace_schemas
summary: Schemas of one workspace.

name: GET /api/activity
summary: Activity per workspace.

name: GET /api/person_tables
summary: Tables one identity used.

name: GET /api/volumes
summary: Volumes with sizes and usage.

name: GET /api/volume_users
summary: Users of one volume.

name: GET /api/tables
summary: Tables with usage class and size.

name: GET /api/people
summary: People and service principals.

name: GET /api/warehouses
summary: Warehouses summary.

name: GET /api/warehouse
summary: One warehouse in detail.

name: GET /api/table
summary: One table in detail.

name: GET /api/table_sizes
summary: Table sizes.

name: GET /api/tag_compliance
summary: Mandatory tag coverage (cached).

name: GET /api/tags
summary: Tag key/value search index (cached).

name: GET /api/findings
summary: One row per executable check with outcome and status counts.

name: GET /api/finding/{query_id}
summary: One check: outcome, header, columns, page of rows.

name: GET /api/finding/{query_id}/aggregate
summary: Server-side GROUP BY over every matching row.

name: GET /
summary: Built index.html with brand injected; /{path} falls back to it.
